description: Implementation of BufferVk class methods for Vulkan rendering in ANGLE project, including buffer management, data setting, copying, mapping, and conversion buffer handling.

classes.name: ConversionBuffer
classes.description: Base class for conversion buffers used in Vulkan rendering.

classes.name: BufferVk::VertexConversionBuffer
classes.description: Derived class for vertex conversion buffers, handling specific format and stride.

classes.name: BufferVk
classes.description: Main class implementing Vulkan buffer management, data operations, and conversion buffer handling.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases internal buffer and conversion buffers.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets data into the buffer, re-creating if size exceeds current buffer.

methods.name: setSubData
methods.description: Updates a subset of buffer data.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps the entire buffer for access.

methods.name: mapRange
methods.description: Maps a range of the buffer for access.

methods.name: mapImpl
methods.description: Implementation detail for mapping the buffer.

methods.name: mapRangeImpl
methods.description: Implementation detail for mapping a range of the buffer.

methods.name: unmapImpl
methods.description: Implementation detail for unmapping the buffer.

methods.name: setDataImpl
methods.description: Internal method to set data, using staging buffer if needed.

methods.name: copyToBuffer
methods.description: Copies buffer data to another buffer.

methods.name: getVertexConversionBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a vertex conversion buffer for specific format and stride.

methods.description: Marks all conversion buffers as dirty.

methods.description: Marks conversion buffers as dirty when data changes.
